post.description: You have a listing id or an etsy.com/listing/{id}/ URL. Use similar_listings for discovery, listing_variations for option prices, shop_sections for the seller's sections.

currency.description:
Currency the listing price is returned in (Etsy's x-detected-locale). price_usd is always returned as well.

Provider reference: allowed values ["USD", "GBP", "EUR"]; default "USD".

listing_id.description:
Numeric Etsy listing id (the number after /listing/ in a listing URL).

Provider reference: minimum 1.

url.description: An etsy.com listing URL: https://www.etsy.com/listing/{id}/..., a regional /uk/listing/{id}/ form or a {shop}.etsy.com/listing/{id} storefront URL.

| `favorites` | number |  |

| `language` | string | Language of title and description as served, e.g. en-US. |
| `listing_id` | number |  |
| `materials` | string[] |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `price` | object | Undiscounted list price in the requested currency; null when Etsy states no price (sold-out listings). During a sale the page shows sale_price instead. |
| `price_usd_minor` | number |  |

currency

200.description:
Variation properties of a listing (for example size or finish) with each value's availability and its price and price difference in the requested currency. Values carry undiscounted list prices; during a sale apply the listing's discount. has_variation_pricing is derived from the prices themselves, and prices_exact is false when Etsy marks the listing variation-priced but publishes the same base price for every option. An empty properties list means the listing has no variations.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `has_variation_pricing` | boolean | True when option prices differ, or when Etsy flags the listing as variation-priced. Corrects Etsy's flag, which is sometimes false while options are priced differently. |
| `listing_id` | number |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `prices_exact` | boolean | False when Etsy flags variation pricing but its public variation data repeats the base price for every option: per-option prices are then not published and values[].price is the base price. |
| `properties` | object[] |  |
| `property_count` | number |  |
| `url` | string | The listing page URL this data belongs to. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Listings Etsy recommends as similar to a seed listing: up to `limit` listing cards with title, URL, price, state, shop and primary image. The only discovery surface reachable without a browser session; results are recommendation-driven and vary between calls. No pagination (the API ignores offsets).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| `is_sold_out` | boolean |  |
| `listing_id` | number |  |
| `price` | object | Undiscounted list price in the requested currency; null when Etsy states no price (sold-out listings). During a sale the page shows sale_price instead. |
| `price_usd_minor` | number | Etsy's USD price in cents, independent of the requested currency. |
| `sale_price` | object | Current sale price the listing page shows, when the listing is discounted and the requested currency is USD; null otherwise (for other currencies use sale_price_usd_minor). |
